description: Implementation of POSIX message queue functions for Zephyr RTOS, including mq_open, mq_close, mq_unlink, mq_send, mq_receive, and related internal functions.

classes.name: mqueue_object
classes.description: Represents a message queue object with associated data and notification settings.

classes.name: mqueue_desc
classes.description: Descriptor for an open message queue, linking to the mqueue_object and holding flags.

methods.name: timespec_to_timeoutms
methods.description: Converts a timespec structure to timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: find_in_list
methods.description: Finds a message queue object in the global list by name.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends a message to the specified message queue descriptor.

methods.name: receive_message
methods.description: Receives a message from the specified message queue descriptor.

methods.name: remove_mq
methods.description: Removes and frees a message queue if its reference count reaches zero.

methods.name: remove_notification
methods.description: Clears notification settings for a message queue.

methods.name: mq_notify_thread
methods.description: Thread function to handle message queue notifications.
